- M9, M11-M20: catalyst deactivation - final conversion depends on catalyst amount

By running at HIGH catalyst concentration, I can:
- Detect deactivation (if final conversion is not complete despite high catalyst, deactivation is happening)
- Test dimerization (rate order in catalyst)
- Look for induction periods

- M3 (dimer is active): very fast (rate ~ [cat]²)

- M9 (cat deactivation): incomplete conversion
- M11 (S+cat deactivation): incomplete conversion, more severe at high [S]
- M6, M8 (activation): induction period visible
- M12, M17 (P inhibition/deactivation): slowdown late in reaction
</hypothesis>
